test_name: Outbound disclosure allowlist excludes unauthorized fields
expected_behavior: Unapproved identifying or recipient-inapplicable fields must not reach the final outbound payload.
failure_condition: An unapproved field exists in the final outbound payload.
required_artifact: request fixture; recipient/purpose policy snapshot; final outbound payload; decision evidence packet

test_name: Purpose and recipient mismatch fails closed
expected_behavior: A transfer with mismatched purpose or recipient must be blocked or routed to review.
failure_condition: Mismatched purpose or recipient is allowed without review.
required_artifact: negative transfer fixture; routing decision trace; audit trace

test_name: Re-identification purpose adversarial detection
expected_behavior: Re-identification intent must be detected across direct and indirect prompt/request forms.
failure_condition: A re-identification request reaches execution without block or review.
required_artifact: adversarial request set; classifier output; decision trace

test_name: Mapping material cannot exit vault boundary
expected_behavior: Mapping keys or re-identification material must not be included in outbound payloads.
failure_condition: Mapping material is present outside the approved vault boundary.
required_artifact: vault access log; outbound payload; deny decision packet

test_name: Transform option evaluation compares privacy and utility
expected_behavior: Candidate transform options must be compared before any transform is promoted.
failure_condition: A transform is selected without privacy and utility evaluation.
required_artifact: privacy risk report; utility report; transform comparison table

test_name: Pseudonymized processing review record exists
expected_behavior: Governance workflow must retain review and audit records for pseudonymized processing.
failure_condition: No review or audit record exists for the processing case.
required_artifact: review checklist; audit trace

test_name: Consent request case is routed for handling
expected_behavior: Consent withdrawal or marketing contact cases must create a reviewable case record.
failure_condition: No case record is created for a request requiring handling.
required_artifact: case record; consent state snapshot

test_name: Provider contract evidence is attached
expected_behavior: Outsourcing processing must have provider and contract review evidence before approval.
failure_condition: Provider processing proceeds without contract or supervision evidence.
required_artifact: contract checklist; provider assessment

test_name: Cross-border destination requires transfer basis
expected_behavior: Cross-border outbound flow must include transfer basis and destination metadata.
failure_condition: Outbound cross-border payload is routed without transfer basis metadata.
required_artifact: destination fixture; transfer basis record; outbound decision trace

test_name: Notice dependency is present where required
expected_behavior: Notice or review artifacts must be attached when the requirement depends on notice.
failure_condition: Transfer review lacks required notice artifact.
required_artifact: notice artifact; review record

test_name: General references remain review-only
expected_behavior: Reference-only requirements must create review context and no runtime decision.
failure_condition: A runtime policy candidate is generated from reference-only requirements.
required_artifact: traceability report; policy candidate inventory

test_name: Unverified electronic finance reference is blocked from promotion
expected_behavior: REVIEW_REQUIRED reference must remain in backlog until source verification.
failure_condition: Dependent control or policy is promoted without source verification.
required_artifact: evidence backlog item; source verification result

test_name: Security monitoring evidence is retained
expected_behavior: Monitoring governance must retain policy, log, and review evidence.
failure_condition: Monitoring control lacks audit or review record.
required_artifact: monitoring policy; audit log; review record

test_name: Privileged account allowlist is enforced
expected_behavior: Only approved privileged accounts may access protected administration flows.
failure_condition: Unapproved privileged account gains access.
required_artifact: account inventory; access policy; negative access fixture

test_name: Admin account event is auditable
expected_behavior: Privileged account decisions must be replayable from audit traces.
failure_condition: Access decision cannot be reconstructed from audit trace.
required_artifact: audit trace; decision packet

test_name: External network path is denied or reviewed
expected_behavior: Unsupported internal-system external network path must not proceed silently.
failure_condition: Unsupported external path succeeds without denial or review.
required_artifact: network path fixture; connection decision log

test_name: Credential and regulated-data detector flags protected fields
expected_behavior: Credential or regulated-data fields must be detected before egress or storage handling.
failure_condition: Protected field is not detected in fixture.
required_artifact: secret fixture; scan report

test_name: Protection evidence is attached before routing
expected_behavior: Protected data routing must include protection evidence.
failure_condition: Protected data is routed without protection evidence.
required_artifact: protected payload evidence; policy snapshot

test_name: AI scope references do not create runtime policy
expected_behavior: AI definition references must remain review context only.
failure_condition: Runtime policy candidate is generated from definition-only references.
required_artifact: AI scope traceability report; policy candidate inventory

test_name: AI usage monitoring record exists
expected_behavior: AI usage involving important data must have monitoring or review records.
failure_condition: AI usage record lacks monitoring or review evidence.
required_artifact: AI usage register; monitoring log

test_name: Sensitive AI input detector catches labeled sensitive examples
expected_behavior: Labeled sensitive AI inputs must be detected before external routing.
failure_condition: Sensitive labeled input reaches external AI without detection.
required_artifact: labeled input fixture; detector report; decision trace

test_name: Transform options remain candidates until evaluated
expected_behavior: Candidate transform options must not be marked final without evaluation artifacts.
failure_condition: A final transform appears without evaluation artifact.
required_artifact: transform option list; evaluation dependency report

test_name: Provider reuse restriction is checked before routing
expected_behavior: External AI routing must verify provider/model-improvement reuse restriction dependency.
failure_condition: Request is routed without provider reuse evidence.
required_artifact: provider terms snapshot; routing decision trace

test_name: SaaS provider review packet exists
expected_behavior: SaaS/cloud provider use must retain provider and security review artifacts.
failure_condition: SaaS use proceeds without provider review packet.
required_artifact: provider assessment; cloud security checklist

test_name: Unverified SaaS requirements block promotion
expected_behavior: REVIEW_REQUIRED SaaS requirements must prevent dependent promotion.
failure_condition: Dependent policy is promoted with unresolved SaaS review requirements.
required_artifact: evidence backlog item; validation report

test_name: Digital asset safeguarding review is retained
expected_behavior: Digital asset safeguarding requirements must produce review evidence, not runtime policy by default.
failure_condition: Runtime policy is generated without safeguarding review basis.
required_artifact: safeguarding review packet; traceability report

test_name: Digital asset REVIEW_REQUIRED references remain backlog
expected_behavior: Unverified digital asset references must remain non-runtime until verified.
failure_condition: Dependent policy is promoted before source verification.
required_artifact: source verification result; evidence backlog item

test_name: Wallet and CDD field classifier separates field classes
expected_behavior: Wallet, transaction, and CDD fields must be classified into separate field groups.
failure_condition: Wallet or CDD field is not classified or is mixed with unrelated fields.
required_artifact: wallet/CDD fixture; field classification report

test_name: Digital asset field routing is auditable
expected_behavior: Digital asset field routing must produce an audit trace and decision packet.
failure_condition: Field routing occurs without audit trace.
required_artifact: audit trace; decision evidence packet
